1.web: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you;
1.asv: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, And lay up my commandments with thee;

2.web: So as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
2.asv: So as to incline thine ear unto wisdom, And apply thy heart to understanding;

3.web: Yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;
3.asv: Yea, if thou cry after discernment, And lift up thy voice for understanding;

4.web: If you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures:
4.asv: If thou seek her as silver, And search for her as for hid treasures:

5.web: then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.
5.asv: Then shalt thou understand the fear of Jehovah, And find the knowledge of God.

6.web: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
6.asv: For Jehovah giveth wisdom; Out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding:

7.web: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity;
7.asv: He layeth up sound wisdom for the upright; He isa shield to them that walk in integrity;

8.web: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.
8.asv: That he may guard the paths of justice, And preserve the way of his saints.

9.web: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.
9.asv: Then shalt thou understand righteousness and justice, And equity, yea, every good path.

10.web: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
10.asv: For wisdom shall enter into thy heart, And knowledge shall be pleasant unto thy soul;

11.web: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
11.asv: Discretion shall watch over thee; Understanding shall keep thee:

12.web: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things;
12.asv: To deliver thee from the way of evil, From the men that speak perverse things;

13.web: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
13.asv: Who forsake the paths of uprightness, To walk in the ways of darkness;

14.web: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil;
14.asv: Who rejoice to do evil, And delight in the perverseness of evil;

15.web: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths:
15.asv: Who are crooked in their ways, And wayward in their paths:

16.web: To deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words;
16.asv: To deliver thee from the strange woman, Even from the foreigner that flattereth with her words;

17.web: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God:
17.asv: That forsaketh the friend of her youth, And forgetteth the covenant of her God:

18.web: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.
18.asv: For her house inclineth unto death, And her paths unto the dead;

19.web: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life:
19.asv: None that go unto her return again, Neither do they attain unto the paths of life:

20.web: that you may walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
20.asv: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, And keep the paths of the righteous.

21.web: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
21.asv: For the upright shall dwell in the land, And the perfect shall remain in it.

22.web: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.
22.asv: But the wicked shall be cut off from the land, And the treacherous shall be rooted out of it.
